mapper.select: /* OrderCommonCsMapper.selectFileShare : 파일조회 */ SELECT FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID , MAX(FSF.SEQ_NO) AS MAX_SEQ_NO , COUNT(FSF.REFERENCE_NO_ID) AS FILE_SHARE_COUNT FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE FS LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_COM_FILE_SHARE_FILE FSF ON FSF.REFERENCE_NO_ID = FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID WHERE FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID = #{referenceNoId} GROUP BY FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID
